_comment: MOH-wide O3 runtime configuration. Loaded after config-core.json and before the
programme and site layers, so it overrides core and is overridden by site.
Must be listed in SPA_CONFIG_URLS — see IMPLEMENTATION.md §7.

_comment_timeout: MOH ICT SOP: 10-minute inactivity timeout. This client-side timer is HALF the
control — it ends the user's session in the browser but does not invalidate a
stolen server session. The matching server-side timeout is configured in the
backend image; both must be present. See the globalproperties/README.md table.
